title: PN Sequence Generator
text: Generate pseudonoise sequence, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Generator polynomial}, {Initial states} sets the initial shift register states, {Output mask source}, {Output mask vector (or scalar shift value)}, {Output variable-size signals} sets the option to output variable-length signals, {Sample time} sets the output sample time, {Samples per frame}, {Maximum output size source}, {Maximum output size}, {Reset on nonzero input}, {Enable bit-packed outputs}, {Number of packed bits} and {Interpret bit-packed values as signed}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial ’z^6 + z + 1’ (default) | character vector | string scalar | binary row vector | integer vector

params.name: Initial states
params.values: Initial shift register states [0 0 0 0 0 1] (default) | binary row vector

params.name: Output mask source
params.values: Output mask source Dialog parameter (default) | Input port

params.name: Output mask vector (or scalar shift value)
params.values: Output mask vector or scalar shift value 0 (default) | integer scalar | binary vector

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Option to output variable-length signals off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum output size source
params.values: Maximum output size source Dialog parameter (default) | Inherit from reference port

params.name: Maximum output size
params.values: Maximum output size [10 1] (default) | vector of the form [ n 1]

params.name: Reset on nonzero input
params.values: Reset on nonzero input off (default) | on

params.name: Number of packed bits
params.values: Number of packed bits 8 (default) | integer in the range [1, 32]

params.name: Interpret bit-packed values as signed
params.values: Interpret bit-packed values as signed off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | boolean | Smallest unsigned integer
